main_text.p: pus ex spicarum virore & maturitate di-judicabant, nulla æqvinoctii ratione habita. Intercalationis igitur sola causa erat frugum maturitas.

Paucis referam, qvod aliqvando legi in Commentario Karaitæ cujusdam, ante 3oo[?] annos, manuscripto in Legem. Ait Karaitas terræ Israelis incolas annos intercalare pro sola ratione mensis Abibh, seu spicarum, ridetqve Gamalielis in Talmud pronunciatum propter tria annum intercalari, propter Spicas, propter Tecuphas,& propter Fructus arborum, אין בן כי האכיב היא לברו נזכר alias Rabban. causas ridet, annos nondum grandes, &c. וידע כי בהמטא האכיב אי אפשר שאין הכל מתוקנים ירלמה נוסיף ער דברי אלהים [illegible, ~4 letters] Notum enim est, inqvit, qvod cum spica reperitur, impossibile est omnia non esse præparata. Ideo mensis primus dicitur אביב; Exod. 13.4. Paulo post idem Autor הנה מורה תויית שי [illegible, ~6 letters] חרשינו בראיר הלבנה ואמר עיר משור

page.notes: Printed page number reads "353"; the third digit is slightly unclear. The Hebrew lines contain several printed boxes or blanks (marked [illegible] above, about 4 and 6 letters), and some Hebrew letters are doubtful, so they are not guaranteed. "3oo" in "ante 3oo annos" is printed with a yogh-like form. The Hebrew and Latin text is given as printed in the scan. Line "ירלמה נוסיף ער דברי אלהים" and "וידע כי בהמטא" are approximate readings.
